title: LOGIC_VERIFICATION.json - 6-dimension logic audit verdict
description: Produced by /logic-verification (Phase 5 'Emit Verdict' in its SKILL.md). The skill's example lists the verdict as PASS|WARN|FAIL|BLOCKED|ERROR, but its 6-state table reserves NOT_APPLICABLE, so the full 6-state vocabulary is accepted here.

verdict.description: PASS = zero FATAL/CRITICAL/MAJOR + counterexample pass executed; FAIL = any FATAL/CRITICAL unresolved.

q_id.description: Frozen Q-id from the document header (INV-G1 problem anchor freeze).

issues.description: Issue entries from the 20-category taxonomy, each with category / axis-A status / axis-B impact / severity / location / minimal fix. Item shape is left open (docs describe it in prose only).

counterexample_pass.description: Counterexample pass is mandatory for key lemmas; candidates are logged even if none found.
